import.title: Import an existing pairing
import.description: Copy the existing PACE-paired identity into a private directory on the Home Assistant server: client.pem, client-key.pem and exactly one pairing-*.json. Enter its absolute path or a path relative to the Home Assistant configuration directory. No heating settings are changed during setup.

pair.title: Prepare pairing
pair.description: Do not activate pairing on the controller yet. Continue to generate a Home Assistant identity and check the MDG connection. Activate pairing only when the next page asks for the connection code. No heating settings will be changed.

pair_code.title: Enter the connection code
pair_code.description: Preparation is complete. Activate pairing on the Danfoss Link CC now and enter the complete remote connection code within one minute. Spaces and hyphens are accepted. After a failed attempt, request a fresh code. The code is not saved.

finish.title: Finish the authenticated pairing
finish.description: PACE pairing and contact exchange succeeded. Continue to save the pairing and read the rooms. If this fails, fix the reported problem and retry here; a new connection code is not needed.

error.invalid_identity: The paired identity is missing, unreadable or inconsistent. Check all three files and their permissions.
error.invalid_auth: The server or controller certificate could not be authenticated. Do not bypass this check.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the controller or MDG servers. Check the internet connection and retry.
error.cannot_prepare: Could not prepare pairing. Check storage permissions and the internet connection, then retry before requesting a code.
error.cannot_store_pairing: Could not save the private identity or pairing. Check free disk space and permissions under .storage/danfoss_link. Existing identities are not overwritten.
error.invalid_code: Enter the complete numeric connection code, not only its last five digits.
error.local_code: Codes starting with 0000 require local LAN pairing, which is not supported. Use a remote connection code.
error.pairing_unavailable: No active pairing was found. The code may be incorrect or expired. Activate pairing again and enter a fresh code.
error.pairing_proof_failed: PACE authentication failed. No controller was trusted. Activate pairing again and enter a fresh code.
error.pairing_failed: Pairing did not complete. Check the controller and connection, then explicitly retry with a fresh code.
error.wrong_controller: This code belongs to a different controller. Reauthentication must use the original controller.
error.already_configured: This controller is already configured. Use its existing integration instead.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: This pairing belongs to a different controller.
abort.reauth_successful: The paired identity was updated successfully.
